verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for a payments platform that handles merchant and transaction data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any AI-training opt-out, data-usage control or policy. The LLM-related items cover docs access and an MCP server, which are unrelated to training on customer data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
